name: Harry & Meghan
description: From their courtship to their exit from royal life, Harry and Meghan share their complex journey in their own words in this docuseries.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As Harry shares the impact of a childhood in the public eye, he and Meghan reflect on the secret, early days of their unexpected romance.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: In 2016, the relationship becomes public -- and public scrutiny begins.  Meghan remembers school, family life, acting and activism before Harry.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The couple's 2017 engagement sparks both cynicism and hope.  As Meghan grapples with royal protocols, tabloid headlines begin to involve her family.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Harry and Meghan's wedding is a resounding success.  But as their popularity grows, internal rifts and media coverage take a worrying toll.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: After private correspondences with their families are leaked, the couple makes a crucial decision -- and ensuing online campaigns turn chilling.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The couple arrives in California, where a friend takes them in.  Amid painful losses and legal battles, Harry and Meghan being to forge their path ahead.
